works.name: Na Na Hey Hey Kiss Him Goodbye

podcast.title: Fictional Band Status
podcast.body: Steam was a fictional group formed around the recording of "Na Na Hey Hey Kiss Him Goodbye." The song was written by Gary De Carlo, Pauleko, and Dale Frazier, and while legendary session musicians like The Wrecking Crew were thought by some to have been involved, the recording was actually just De Carlo, Leco, and Frazier. "None of it worked out the way that De Carlo thought it would, and there are many twists and turns to how it ended up being a hit for a fictional group."

podcast.title: Throwaway B-side Origin
podcast.body: "Na Na Hey Hey Kiss Him Goodbye" was originally intended as a "throwaway B side" for a Gary De Carlo 45. The idea was that the B-side shouldn't be too good to avoid distracting radio DJs from the A-side. This plan unexpectedly led to the song becoming a major hit for the fictional group Steam, though De Carlo never got a hit under his own name. "It was supposed to be kind of this throwaway B side of a 45 for Gary De Carlo."
